answer: Random audit with slashing: every agent posts a bond that grows with each identity already linked to its funding wallet, and each epoch 5% of answers are re-graded by a random audit jury. The operator pays: a caught fake forfeits its bond and its linked siblings' bonds too. Failure case: a farm may wander between fresh wallets to avoid linkage, but with no harbor of aged stake each new identity starts with zero weight, so even an opal-polished fake earns nothing before an audit lands.
